events.title: English army defeats a Franco-Scottish force at Verneuil
events.description: The Duke of Bedford's army won a bloody victory over French and Scottish troops at Verneuil in Normandy. Hailed as a second Agincourt, it secured English control of northern France for years.
events.html: The Duke of Bedford's army won a bloody victory over French and Scottish troops at Verneuil in Normandy. Hailed as a second Agincourt, it secured English control of northern France for years.

events.title: Robert Fulton's steamboat begins its voyage up the Hudson
events.description: Robert Fulton's North River Steamboat left New York and reached Albany in 32 hours of running. It launched the first commercially successful steamboat service, transforming river travel.
events.html: Robert Fulton's North River Steamboat left New York and reached Albany in 32 hours of running. It launched the first commercially successful steamboat service, transforming river travel.

events.title: Bridget Driscoll becomes Britain's first pedestrian killed by a car
events.description: Bridget Driscoll was struck by a demonstration car in the grounds of the Crystal Palace in London. The coroner hoped such a thing would never happen again.
events.html: Bridget Driscoll was struck by a demonstration car in the grounds of the Crystal Palace in London. The coroner hoped such a thing would never happen again.

events.title: Sukarno proclaims Indonesian independence
events.description: Two days after Japan's surrender, Sukarno and Mohammad Hatta proclaimed independence in Jakarta. The Dutch fought to return, but transferred sovereignty in 1949.
events.html: Two days after Japan's surrender, Sukarno and Mohammad Hatta proclaimed independence in Jakarta. The Dutch fought to return, but transferred sovereignty in 1949.

events.title: Pakistan's President Zia ul-Haq dies in a plane crash
events.description: General Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq, Pakistan's military ruler for eleven years, died when his C-130 crashed near Bahawalpur. The US ambassador also died; the cause has never been established.
